job.job_description:
Hiring IT Developers AI/ML | Hyderabad | RCM Background | Apply Now

We are hiring experienced AI/ML professionals for multiple positions in our Engineering & Technology AI/ML Platform Engineering team. If you have a strong background in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) along with AI/ML expertise, we would love to hear from you.




Open Positions

1. Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer – AI/ML

Experience: 3–7 Years

Key Skills:

AI/ML, NLP, and Conversational AI development
Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer Models
OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain
TensorFlow, PyTorch
Rasa, AWS Lex, Dialogflow
Vector Databases: Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, ChromaDB
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)



2. SLM Data Science Lead – Architect (AI/ML)

Experience: 10+ Years

Role Level:

Principal / Architect
Individual Contributor with Enterprise Technical Leadership

Key Skills:

Machine Learning Algorithms (Random Forest, SVM, Regression, Boosting, Bagging)
Deep Learning (CNN, RNN, LSTM, GRU)
Advanced NLP & Large Language Models
Expert Python Programming
Cloud-based ML Architecture & Deployment
Enterprise AI Governance & Best Practices

Educational Qualification:

ME / BE / MCA / PhD
PhD Preferred



3. Principal Architect – AI/ML

Experience: 12+ Years

Key Skills:

MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI, Airflow
Generative AI / LLMs
RAG, Embeddings, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
AI Platform Architecture & Enterprise AI Solutions

Education:

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
Cloud Certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP) preferred



Mandatory Requirements

Experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain is mandatory.
Strong AI/ML development and architecture experience based on the role.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Ability to work on enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions.

Job Location

Hyderabad

Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
Opportunity to build enterprise-scale AI platforms.
Excellent career growth in a high-performing engineering team.
Competitive salary based on experience.



Interested Candidates

Contact: 9603931383
Email: Maragani.DurgaDevi@axisservice.co.in

Apply today if you're passionate about AI/ML innovation and have experience in the RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) domain!
